questions.question: Vasco da Gama, a Portuguese explorer, discovered the sea route to India in ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1498
  • Landing: He landed at Calicut (Kozhikode), opening the sea route from Europe to India around the Cape of Good Hope.

questions.question: Which of the following towns was grown as a temple town during the Chola dynasty?
questions.solution:
• Temple Town: Bhillasvamin (Vidisha)
  • Growth: Towns like this grew around major temples due to the economy generated by pilgrims and donations.

questions.question: Quwwat al-Islam mosque and minaret, built during the last decade of the ______ century.
questions.solution:
• Century: Twelfth
  • Fact: Part of the Qutb Minar complex, it was the first mosque built in Delhi after the conquest.

questions.question: The group of islands which form part of India and lie to the southeast of Indian mainland in Bay of Bengal is ______.
questions.solution:
• Islands: Andaman and Nicobar islands
  • Geography: Located at the junction of the Bay of Bengal and the Andaman Sea.

questions.question: The Hindu College was established in Banaras in ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1791
  • Founder: Jonathan Duncan established it for the study of Hindu Law and Literature.

questions.question: The Harappan brought Gold from present-day _______ in India.
questions.solution:
• State: Karnataka
  • Mining: The Kolar gold mines are one of the oldest in the world.

questions.question: Which of the following has discovered the sea route to India 1498?
questions.solution:
• Explorer: Vasco Da Gama
  • Origin: A Portuguese explorer commissioned by King Manuel I.

questions.question: The British physicist named Paul Dirac was known to have introduced the concept of _________ in 1930.
questions.solution:
• Concept: Antiparticle
  • Physics: He predicted the existence of the positron (anti-electron) through the Dirac Equation.

questions.question: Abhinav Bharat Society was a secret society of revolutionaries. It was established in __________.
questions.solution:
• Region: Bombay Presidency
  • Founder: V.D. Savarkar and his brother Ganesh Savarkar in 1904.

questions.question: Which of the following type of house remains were found in Mehrgarh site of Harappan civilization?
questions.solution:
• Shape: Square or rectangular
  • Life: These houses often had four or more compartments, some used for storage.

questions.question: Which of the following revolutionaries stated during his trial that “he did not wish to glorify the cult of the bomb and pistol but wanted a revolution in society”?
questions.solution:
• Revolutionary: Bhagat Singh
  • Ideology: He shifted the focus from individual acts of violence to mass mobilization and socialist revolution.

questions.question: Ashoka appointed ______ to solve the social problems in his region.
questions.solution:
• Officers: Dhamma Mahamatta
  • Role: They were specialized officials who traveled to spread the message of Dhamma and ensure social harmony.

questions.question: The first session of All India Depressed Classes congress was held at __________ in 1930.
questions.solution:
• Location: Nagpur
  • Presided by: B.R. Ambedkar; it was a landmark step for the political mobilization of Dalits.

questions.question: Which of the following territories to the south and north were made part of the Chola kingdom by the successors of the ruler Vijayalaya?
questions.solution:
• Territories: Pandyan and Pallava
  • Expansion: Successors like Aditya I and Parantaka I absorbed these neighboring kingdoms into the Chola Empire.

questions.question: Which act allows the government to confiscate the assets of newspaper in case of publishing anything “objectionable”?
questions.solution:
• Act: Vernacular Press Act, 1878
  • Nature: It allowed the government to seize the printing press of any newspaper deemed seditious.

questions.question: Which of the following commissions recommended that “the appointment of Governor should be non-partisan”?
questions.solution:
• Commission: Sarkaria commission (1983)
  • Mandate: To examine the Centre-State relations and suggest constitutional reforms.

questions.question: Techniques of making silk were first invented in China around _____ years ago.
questions.solution:
• Years: 7000 years ago
  • Secret: China kept the process of sericulture (silk farming) a secret for thousands of years.

questions.question: Against whom was the Battle of Plassey (1751) fought by the English Company led by Robert Clive?
questions.solution:
• Against: Siraj Ud Daulah
  • Result: Mir Jafar’s betrayal led to the Nawab's defeat and execution.

questions.question: Name the committee constituted for village and small scale industries in 1955?
questions.solution:
• Committee: Karve Committee
  • Focus: Emphasized using small-scale industries to promote rural development and employment.

questions.question: Which of the following Acts of the British Parliament stated that a member of the British Cabinet was appointed Secretary of State for India?
questions.solution:
• Act: Government of India Act of 1858
  • New Post: The Secretary of State was a member of the British Cabinet and was responsible for the governance of India.

questions.question: Partition of Bengal held in ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1905
  • Viceroy: Lord Curzon partitioned Bengal, which led to the Swadeshi Movement.

questions.question: In which year was India House established by Shyamji Verma?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1905
  • City: London.

questions.question: Prithviraja III defeated an Afghan ruler named ______ in 1191.
questions.solution:
• Afghan Ruler: Sultan Muhammad Ghori
  • Battles: Ghori lost in 1191 but won the rematch in 1192.

questions.question: Which of the following sites of Harappan civilization is located near Bolan Pass?
questions.solution:
• Site: Mehrgarh
  • Bolon Pass: It was a vital link between the Indus Valley and the Iranian plateau.

questions.question: Which dynasty bronze statues were made using the “lost wax” technique?
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Chola
  • Art: The Dancing Shiva (Nataraja) is the most famous example of Chola bronze casting.
